0c38661d19db3b24.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة تموين القمه لخدمات الاعاشة عن أخصائي مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تقييم احتياجات الشراء، ومسح السوق للحصول على أفضل الأسعار، وإدارة عروض الموردين، وبناء قواعد بيانات للمواد والموردين. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال المشتريات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم احتياجات ومتطلبات الوحدات التنظيمية المختلفة من المواد وتحديد أولويات الشراء بناءً على ذلك. إجراء دراسات وتحليلات متخصصة ومسح للسوق بهدف الحصول على أفضل أسعار الشراء من الموردين، وضمان الجودة المطلوبة للمواد وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. الإشراف على عمليات وإجراءات استلام العروض من موردي الخدمات وتقييمها بالتنسيق مع الوحدات الإدارية الأخرى، والتأكد من مطابقتها للإجراءات المعتمدة. بناء قاعدة بيانات لأسعار المواد المستهلكة بشكل متكرر وأهم الموردين لها، والاحتفاظ بملفات متكاملة لعمليات الشراء المختلفة وفقاً للنظام المعتمد. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المشتريات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات وتحديد أولويات الشراء بفعالية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض مع الموردين للحصول على أفضل الأسعار والجودة. القدرة على بناء وإدارة قواعد بيانات للموردين والأسعار. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم السوق والعروض. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة بدقة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع الموردين والوحدات الداخلية. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لعمليات الشراء. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. سيعمل أخصائي المشتريات ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة تموين القمه لخدمات الاعاشة، مما يساهم في ضمان توفير المواد والخدمات بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

0cbbc0f1f494b103.description: About the Role Zahran Facilities Management is seeking an experienced Electronic Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on the operation, maintenance, and reliability of electronic, ELV (Extra-Low Voltage), and security systems within a project site. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities The Electronic Engineer will be responsible for a range of tasks, ensuring optimal performance and reliability of critical systems. Key responsibilities include: Operating and maintaining assigned non-medical electronic and ELV systems according to the O&M plan. Maintaining CCTV cameras, video management and recording systems, and associated monitoring equipment. Managing access control systems, including controllers, card readers, door hardware, and related interfaces. Coordinating maintenance and fault response for fire alarm panels, detectors, and notification devices with authorized providers. Maintaining public address, voice evacuation, intercom, and background music systems. Maintaining structured cabling, racks, patch panels, and communications infrastructure in coordination with IT. Reviewing alarms, event logs, device status, and communications links; logging incidents and escalating service faults. Tracing faults in field devices, wiring, power supplies, controllers, and links using approved tools and procedures. Coordinating approved interfaces between security, fire alarm, communications, and other building systems. Conducting site inspections and reliability checks; verifying corrective work restores normal operation. Building Automation and Controls This role involves maintaining electronic controls and building automation interfaces, including: Building Management System (BMS) controllers, field devices, and operator workstations. Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) or other approved monitoring interfaces. Electronic sensors, actuators, control panels, and communications gateways. System interfaces with HVAC, lighting, power monitoring, and security systems, where applicable. Networked system components and approved remote monitoring connections. Utilizing approved drawings, manuals, and control sequences; reporting discrepancies and recurring defects. Performing functional checks and coordinating specialist visits with IT, safety, and facilities teams. Preventive Maintenance and Reliability The Electronic Engineer will play a crucial role in ensuring the long-term reliability of electronic and ELV assets: Planning preventive and corrective maintenance for assigned assets under the O&M schedule. Diagnosing faults, coordinating repairs, and restoring service promptly while minimizing disruption. Maintaining critical spares and coordinating vendor, specialist, and service-provider support. Supervising contractor work, verifying service quality, and following up on work orders and service-level requirements. Documentation and Compliance Accurate documentation and adherence to compliance standards are essential for this position: Maintaining asset registers, maintenance schedules, inspection records, system logs, drawings, and compliance records. Preparing reports on system condition, faults, downtime, and completed work at required intervals. Ensuring work follows site safety procedures, approved method statements, manufacturer guidance, and project requirements. Supporting audits, emergency readiness, and continuous improvement of system reliability and service delivery. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess the following qualifications and experience: A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant electronic engineering role. Demonstrated expertise in the operation and maintenance of electronic, ELV, and security systems. Strong understanding of building automation and control systems. Ability to diagnose faults and coordinate effective repair solutions. Proficiency in maintaining accurate documentation and ensuring compliance with safety and project standards.

0ca721acba5745e7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة منار العمران للتجارة والصناعة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بدءًا من إعداد المستندات المحاسبية وحتى إعداد التقارير المالية، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام المالية والإدارية لضمان دقة السجلات المحاسبية والامتثال للإجراءات المعتمدة. تشمل هذه المهام: إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المحاسبية. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا الدور، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. معرفة جيدة بأساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب الدور مهارات تحليلية وتنظيمية قوية، بالإضافة إلى القدرة على مواكبة التطورات في مجال المحاسبة: مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإدارة المستندات والسجلات المالية. دقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد التقارير والتسويات. القدرة على تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع الجهات الداخلية والخارجية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق عمل شركة منار العمران للتجارة والصناعة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

0cf61e6422519337.description: Job description About the role We are seeking a Senior Associate to manage end‑to‑end post‑trade custody operations for the Saudi Arabia (KSA) market , covering securities settlement, cash & FX operational support, corporate actions and income, reconciliations, and onboarding/account setup – Sunday to Thursday . This role requires strong familiarity with local market practices and a solid understanding of the KSA post‑trade ecosystem: trading on Saudi Exchange , clearing via Muqassa (CCP) , and depository/settlement via Edaa , with settlement cash movements supported through SAMA . Why this role is important to us State Street is one of the world’s largest global custodians, with over USD 51.7 trillion in AUC/A , and is executing a growth strategy that includes expanding direct market presence. As part of this strategy, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) is a priority market , supported by Vision 2030 reforms , increasing foreign participation, and strong institutional demand. This role is critical to: Enabling scalable market entry and growth by delivering strong, controlled post‑trade operations aligned to local market infrastructure and rules. Ensuring a high-quality client experience through timely settlement, strong exception management, and robust controls as KSA market activity expands. Supporting the firm’s ability to deepen relationships with key institutional clients as the market evolves. Key responsibilities (KSA-specific) 1) Clearing & settlement operations (Cash Market – Equities / ETFs / Sukuk & Bonds as applicable) Manage settlement processing for Saudi Exchange transactions settling at Edaa , ensuring accurate, timely completion across relevant cycles (e.g., T+2 for normal exchange trades; negotiated deals T+0–T+5 ; buy‑ins T+0 , as applicable). Reconcile and validate trade/settlement obligations by aligning client instructions and broker confirmations with clearing outcomes (Muqassa) and settlement processing (Edaa); investigate and resolve exceptions promptly. Monitor settlement status proactively, manage potential fails, and follow KSA fails workflows noting that fails management procedures are defined and conducted by Muqassa , with Edaa rollover/cancellation and market-claim handling where applicable. Manage lifecycle of settlement instructions (including amendments/cancellations/partial settlement where permitted) in line with Edaa procedures and local cut‑offs. 2) Cash settlement & funding (SAMA) Ensure funding readiness for DvP settlement , understanding that KSA settlement is gross on the securities leg and netted on the cash leg , with cash settlement executed via SAMA settlement member accounts. Perform cash reconciliations linked to settlement activity; investigate breaks and drive timely resolution within cut‑offs. 3) FX operations (operational support) Process FX-related operational activities supporting settlement and client cash requirements (settlement-linked and standalone requests per operating model), validating confirmations and ensuring correct value dating and SSI usage. 4) Corporate actions, dividends & income Manage corporate actions and income events, ensuring accurate entitlements, timely postings, and robust reconciliations; coordinate vendor feeds and security setup with internal market data/static data teams as required. 5) Client onboarding & investor identification Support onboarding/account setup and documentation in line with Edaa account structures and membership rules; ensure correct capture/validation of investor identification in Edaa’s framework (Investor Identification Number / Investor ID ). Support QFI onboarding requirements within the local custody/account operating model to ensure settlement readiness. 6) Messaging, controls & stakeholder management Use SWIFT ISO 15022 (MT) and exposure to ISO 20022 (MX) standards for settlement/reconciliation/corporate actions messaging with clients/custodians and market counterparts, supporting high STP and clean exception handling. Execute daily controls and checklists on time; ensure adherence to local cut‑offs and internal policies; escalate high‑risk/time‑sensitive issues with clear impact articulation. Partner with internal teams (Operations, Risk, Client Services) and external stakeholders (brokers, clearing/settlement participants, custodians, relevant market entities) to resolve issues and improve outcomes. Experience & preferred qualifications Bachelor’s degree (or above) in Finance, Accounting, or related field. 3–5 years’ experience in custody/post‑trade operations (KSA market experience strongly preferred). Strong understanding of KSA post‑trade flow across Muqassa (clearing/CCP) and Edaa (CSD/settlement) , and the implications of T+2 and DvP cash settlement via SAMA . Strong analytical/problem-solving skills, attention to detail, ability to work under strict cut-offs, and strong stakeholder management. About State Street Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. End Date: October 22, 2026, 2026. For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below. 0c4fd5ccdeb3c34c.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking an Inspector I Structural & Architectural QC to join their team in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring that all structural and architectural construction activities, including fabrication and erection, are executed safely, effectively, and efficiently. Key Responsibilities Verify the identity of structural materials (plate, beam, angle, etc.) and their conformance to installation drawings and specifications. Confirm that fit-up and welding inspections have been performed and joints have been released. Verify that dimensions and alignment tolerances of structural components adhere to permissible limits within construction specifications, drawings, and other applicable documents, utilizing advanced dimension check equipment such as EDM, theodolite, and dumpy level. Conduct random surveillance, cross-verification, and in-process surveillance to ensure compliance with approved specifications, WPS, weld consumables, and the use of qualified welders and weld processes. Perform walkdown inspections and punch listing for structural components, verifying that punch list items are addressed according to contractual arrangements. Witness final acceptance of structures and associated items, including any applicable final tests. Complete and endorse all inspection records from initial inspection through to final acceptance of structural and associated work. Maintain communication with the Client to ensure all contractual and code requirements related to the inspection scope are met. Develop and implement all necessary standards and procedures for performing inspections and tests, overseeing all testing methods while maintaining high quality standards. Develop method statements for activities when required, including risk assessment, job safety & environmental analysis, Inspection & Test Plan, and Checklists based on project specifications. Ensure adherence to all applicable information security policies and procedures. Proficiency in using dimension check equipment such as EDM, theodolite, and dumpy level is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic industrial environment, collaborating with various teams to ensure the highest standards of quality and safety in structural and architectural construction projects.

0cae1f215ee2f64c.description: About the Coop - Actuarial Role at Bupa Arabia Bupa Arabia is offering a Coop - Actuarial internship opportunity in Jeddah.
